text: The landslide caused the Earthquake, not that earthquake caused the landslide & flood afterwards. In Short form it is also called LDOF (Landslide Dam Outburst Flood). Landslide occurred at 8:37 am in the morning. Coordinates of the landslide start: 28.292148, 85.517571 Land debris/ Ice debris fell down from 5200m elevation to 2800m elevation and blocked the river at the confluence of two rivers at this place (28.331608, 85.485585). Water got accumulated at that place for 15 minutes or so and then it burst out from that moraine dam and took everything away on its path downstream. It's mudslide because of that mixture of water and moraine dam debris. If that landslide was identified immediately and the river's blockage was identified at that time via drone inspection and other measures; Many lives would have been saved. People could have evacuated immediately in the span of 20 minutes and climbed nearby hills to elevation higher than HFL. The people who survived mostly anticipated LDOF might occur and evacuated earlier, but the ones who didn't and waited to see the flood rush just to activate their adrenaline & evacuate went missing in many places. The major miss in technological & early warning system was negligence of LDOF occurrence, it should have been inspected immediately & information should've been relayed immediately. Within minutes is what we should have be capable of responding; at least from the Tibetan side. I've researched on similar cases related with TSHO-Rolpa GLOF possibilities & it's wayyy more massive than this.
